items.rationale: Overvoltage damage to a fixed AC installation is a building component covered under 2.3.3, and a like-for-like replacement is reinstatement under 7.1.1/7.1.9. Uncertainty: the cause is described only as a 'power surge' (lightning is not stated), and earlier kitchen units were declined. Reference rate is about 1,413 per piece.
Labour to put a covered like-for-like replacement in place is an ancillary charge that follows its principal item under 7.1.11. Indemnified if the AC unit is, at the reference rate of about 480.

An equivalent stand for a surge-damaged console unit is reinstatement, as in case 38 (54-67). However, the unit it belongs to is not on this invoice, so whether it is allocable to an affected part (9.5, 7.1.9(a)) is uncertain.
Freight is an ancillary charge that follows the covered replacement unit under 7.1.11. Reference rate is about 43.
